items.title: Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205)
items.summary: Developers and deployers of high-risk AI systems face impact assessments, disclosure, and anti-discrimination duties.

items.title: Climate-related financial risk reporting (SB 261)
items.summary: Qualifying entities must biennially report climate-related financial risks and mitigation measures under CARB oversight.

items.title: Climate corporate disclosure (SB 253)
items.summary: Large U.S. companies doing business in California must disclose Scope 1–3 greenhouse gas emissions with third-party assurance phases.

items.title: DELETE Act — one-stop data broker deletion (signed)
items.summary: Creates a CPPA-operated mechanism for consumers to request deletion across registered data brokers, with phased compliance.

items.title: Maryland Online Data Privacy Act (MODPA)
items.summary: Maryland privacy law restricts sale of sensitive data and sets consumer rights for Maryland residents.

items.title: Minnesota Consumer Data Privacy Act
items.summary: Minnesota joins state privacy patchwork with consumer rights, consent requirements, and contractor obligations.

items.title: Data broker registration (NY privacy law)
items.summary: Data brokers meeting definition must register with the NY Attorney General and maintain a consumer opt-out.

items.title: Delaware franchise tax & annual report
items.summary: Delaware-incorporated entities owe annual franchise tax and must file reports by March 1.

items.title: Paid prenatal personal leave
items.summary: New York employees may take paid leave for prenatal healthcare appointments under the paid sick leave law.

items.title: Montana Consumer Data Privacy Act (2023)
items.summary: Montana privacy law provides consumer rights including opt-out of sale and targeted advertising.

items.title: Texas business courts for complex commercial cases
items.summary: Dedicated business court divisions handle large commercial disputes with specialized judges in major counties.

items.title: Delaware General Corporation Law updates
items.summary: Delaware regularly amends DGCL — recent changes affect stockholder rights, fiduciary duties, and entity governance.

items.title: Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (TDPSA)
items.summary: Texas privacy law applies to many businesses without revenue thresholds; requires privacy notices, opt-outs, and data protection assessments.

items.title: Oregon Consumer Privacy Act (OCPA)
items.summary: Oregon privacy law includes consumer rights, universal opt-out, and DPIA requirements for high-risk processing.

items.title: Florida Digital Bill of Rights (scaled)
items.summary: Privacy rights for consumers against large tech platforms; scope narrowed from original proposal — verify applicability thresholds.

items.title: Fast food minimum wage & council framework (AB 1228)
items.summary: California fast-food workers receive a higher statewide minimum wage; sector council authority was narrowed after referendum.

items.title: My Health My Data Act (MHMDA)
items.summary: Broad consumer health data privacy law with consent, geofencing, and deletion rights — beyond HIPAA-covered entities.

items.title: Texas franchise tax no-tax-due threshold
items.summary: Entities below the annualized total revenue threshold may file a no-tax-due report instead of owing franchise tax.

items.title: NC unemployment insurance employer accounts
items.summary: Employers fund unemployment insurance; new businesses register for NCUI tax accounts when hiring.
items.sourceLabel: North Carolina Division of Employment Security

items.title: Paid Leave for All Workers Act
items.summary: Most Illinois employers must provide paid leave employees can use for any reason, accrued per hour worked.

items.title: Florida Telemarketing Act compliance
items.summary: Telephone solicitation rules require licensing, calling-hour limits, and Do Not Call compliance for covered sellers.

items.title: Data broker registration with CPPA
items.summary: Businesses that sell personal information they did not collect directly must register with the CPPA and pay an annual fee.

items.title: Utah Consumer Privacy Act (UCPA)
items.summary: Utah consumers may access, delete, and opt out of sale of personal data; lighter obligations than CPRA for many businesses.

items.title: NYC Local Law 144 — automated employment decision tools
items.summary: NYC employers using AI for hiring must conduct annual bias audits and provide candidate notices.
items.sourceLabel: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection

items.title: WA Cares long-term care benefit
items.summary: Most Washington workers contribute to a state long-term care insurance benefit; exemptions exist for out-of-state workers.

items.title: Connecticut Data Privacy Act (CTDPA)
items.summary: Connecticut privacy law grants consumer rights and imposes controller obligations including data protection assessments.

items.title: Colorado Privacy Act (CPA)
items.summary: Colorado consumers gain access, correction, deletion, and opt-out rights; controllers need privacy notices and data protection assessments.

items.title: CPPA final CPRA regulations
items.summary: California Privacy Protection Agency regulations clarify opt-out signals, audits, cybersecurity, and automated decision-making disclosures.

items.title: Climate Commitment Act cap-and-invest
items.summary: Large emitters must obtain allowances for greenhouse gas emissions; affects energy-intensive operations.

items.title: Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA)
items.summary: Virginia consumers receive access, correction, deletion, and opt-out rights similar to other state privacy laws.

items.title: California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) operational rules
items.summary: CPRA expands CCPA with new consumer rights, sensitive data limits, and contractor/service-provider obligations for businesses meeting thresholds.

items.title: Employee & B2B CCPA exemptions expired
items.summary: Personal information collected in employment and certain B2B contexts is fully covered by CCPA/CPRA after exemption sunset.

items.title: Property insurance market reforms
items.summary: Legislative packages address assignment of benefits, litigation costs, and Citizens Property Insurance eligibility.

items.title: Marketplace facilitator sales tax collection
items.summary: Marketplace providers must collect and remit Florida sales tax on facilitated sales.

items.title: Statewide paid sick leave
items.summary: Employers must provide paid sick leave accrual based on employer size; covers diagnosis, care, and domestic violence leave.

items.title: Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML)
items.summary: Massachusetts employers and workers fund paid family and medical leave benefits administered by the Department of Family and Medical Leave.
items.sourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Family and Medical Leave

items.title: Colorado pay transparency in job postings
items.summary: Employers with Colorado employees must include compensation and benefits in public job postings.
items.sourceLabel: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment

items.title: Virginia ban on noncompetes for low-wage workers
items.summary: Employers may not enter noncompete agreements with low-wage employees as defined by statute.

items.title: New Jersey pay equity reporting (Diane B. Allen Act)
items.summary: Certain public contractors must report employee compensation by gender, race, and job category.
items.sourceLabel: New Jersey Department of the Treasury

items.title: Georgia marketplace facilitator sales tax
items.summary: Marketplace facilitators must collect and remit Georgia sales tax on third-party sales.

items.title: Stop Hacks and Improve Electronic Data Security (SHIELD) breach notification
items.summary: Expanded breach notification and security program requirements for NY residents' private information.
items.sourceLabel: New York Department of Financial Services

items.title: NY SHIELD Act data security requirements
items.summary: Businesses holding private information of NY residents must implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards.
items.sourceLabel: New York Department of Financial Services

items.title: Washington data breach notification
items.summary: Entities must notify affected Washington residents and the Attorney General when personal information is compromised.

items.title: Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML)
items.summary: Employers and employees fund statewide paid leave for medical and family events; reporting required for covered employers.

items.title: Noncompete agreement income thresholds
items.summary: Noncompetes are void for employees below statutory earnings thresholds and banned for certain workers.

items.title: Texas Identity Theft Enforcement and Protection Act updates
items.summary: Businesses must notify Texas residents of breaches of sensitive personal information and report large breaches to the AG.

items.title: AI video interview disclosure (IVAA)
items.summary: Employers using AI to analyze video interviews must notify applicants and explain how AI is used.

items.title: Nevada privacy opt-out for sale of covered information
items.summary: Consumers may direct operators not to sell certain covered information; operators must provide a designated request method.

items.title: Vermont data broker regulation
items.summary: Data brokers must register annually with the Vermont Secretary of State and meet minimum data security standards.

items.title: Florida corporate income tax economic nexus
items.summary: Out-of-state corporations with substantial Florida sales may owe corporate income tax even without physical presence.

items.title: Massachusetts Noncompetition Agreement Act
items.summary: Noncompetes must meet garden-leave or consideration requirements and cannot exceed 12 months for most employees.

items.title: Arizona data breach notification
items.summary: Entities must notify Arizona residents of unauthorized acquisition of unencrypted personal information.

items.title: South Dakota breach notification law
items.summary: Businesses must notify South Dakota residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Alabama Data Breach Notification Act
items.summary: Covered entities must notify Alabama residents and the Attorney General of qualifying data breaches.

items.title: New Mexico Data Breach Notification Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify New Mexico residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Delaware data breach notification law
items.summary: Persons conducting business in Delaware must notify residents and the Attorney General of qualifying breaches.

items.title: Wyoming data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Wyoming residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: BitLicense virtual currency business regulation
items.summary: Virtual currency businesses serving New York generally need a BitLicense or limited-purpose trust charter from NY DFS.
items.sourceLabel: New York Department of Financial Services

items.title: Kentucky data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Kentucky residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Iowa consumer data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Iowa residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: Florida Information Protection Act (FIPA)
items.summary: Businesses must notify Floridians and regulators of data breaches involving personal information within 30 days.

items.title: Public benefit corporation statutes
items.summary: Delaware allows public benefit corporations with expanded director duties to stakeholders beyond stockholders.

items.title: Mississippi data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Mississippi residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Massachusetts data security regulations (201 CMR 17.00)
items.summary: Businesses holding MA residents' personal information must maintain a written information security program (WISP).

items.title: Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI)
items.summary: Requires informed consent before capturing biometric identifiers and limits retention and disclosure.
items.sourceLabel: Texas Legislature — Business & Commerce Code Ch. 503

items.title: Missouri data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Missouri residents when personal information is compromised.

items.title: Alaska personal information protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Alaska residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Oklahoma Security Breach Notification Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Oklahoma residents of unauthorized access to personal information.

items.title: Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA)
items.summary: Private entities need written consent and a retention policy before collecting fingerprints, face scans, or other biometrics.

items.title: South Carolina Financial Identity Fraud and Identity Theft Protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify South Carolina residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Georgia film & digital entertainment tax credit
items.summary: Qualified production companies may claim transferable tax credits — relevant for media and content startups.

items.title: North Dakota breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify North Dakota residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: Ohio data breach notification law
items.summary: Entities must notify Ohio residents of breaches of personal information without unreasonable delay.

items.title: Michigan data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Michigan residents and provide notice to the Attorney General for large breaches.

items.title: Kansas breach of consumer security information
items.summary: Businesses must notify Kansas residents when personal information is acquired without authorization.

items.title: New Hampshire security breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify New Hampshire residents of unauthorized access to personal information.

items.title: Indiana disclosure of security breach
items.summary: Businesses must notify Indiana residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Idaho breach notification law
items.summary: Businesses must notify Idaho residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: Hawaii security breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Hawaii residents of unauthorized access to personal information.

items.title: Rhode Island Identity Theft Protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Rhode Island residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Wisconsin data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Wisconsin residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: Pennsylvania breach of personal information notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Pennsylvania residents when personal information is disclosed without authorization.

items.title: Nebraska Financial Data Protection and Consumer Notification of Data Security Breach Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Nebraska residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Maine data breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify Maine residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Louisiana Database Security Breach Notification Law
items.summary: Businesses must notify Louisiana residents of breaches of personal information.

items.title: Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA)
items.summary: Illinois requires reasonable security measures and breach notification for personal information.

items.title: North Carolina Identity Theft Protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify NC residents and the Attorney General of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Arkansas Personal Information Protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Arkansas residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: West Virginia consumer credit and protection act — breach notification
items.summary: Businesses must notify West Virginia residents of security breaches involving personal information.

items.title: Tennessee Identity Theft Deterrence Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Tennessee residents of unauthorized access to personal information.

items.title: New Jersey Identity Theft Prevention Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify New Jersey residents of breaches of personal information without unreasonable delay.
items.sourceLabel: New Jersey Office of the Attorney General

items.title: Georgia Personal Identity Protection Act
items.summary: Businesses must notify Georgia residents of unauthorized acquisition of personal information.

items.title: Texas sales tax on data processing & SaaS
items.summary: Certain cloud, SaaS, and data processing services are taxable in Texas when provided for consideration.
